messages:
marta: Quick alignment thread We need a lean GA-ready checklist for the upcoming roadmap cut. Targeting launch window next week. Core buckets: SLA commitments, runbooks/docs, oncall/responder plan, observability/alerts, and pricing/quotas. I sketched a small digest below.

kevin: Let's avoid introducing new SLOs we can't show 30d telemetry for. Keep targets achievable.

marta: Draft checklist: 
- SLA: 99.9% monthly availability, p95 < 450ms, p99 < 1.1s (conditional on canary), translate to outage minutes in doc.
- Docs: public getting-started, migration notes for model variants, internal runbook with rollback + customer comms templates.
- Oncall: 1-week overlap of serving + SRE on support queue during launch; escalation matrix with 1h initial ack for Sev1.
- Observability: regional synthetic checks (us, eu), KV cache hit-rate, request size distribution, and failure-budget burn alerting.
- Pricing & quotas: staging pricing page live, clear burst policy, and a documented emergency credit flow.

indra: Observability: also capture model-variant fallback count and tail-latency histograms. Add a canary job verifying p95/p99 on representative workloads for 48h.

vik: For SLA, quantify failure budget as minutes. 0.1% translates to ~43 minutes/month at 30d; 0.1% vs 0.01% discussion aside, but we need to be explicit.

ashley: I'll draft the customer-facing FAQ on common failure modes + recommended mitigations. Also propose an email template for notifying customers of degraded performance and expected ETA.

kevin: Can we commit to a pre-GA runbook walkthrough with support on Thursday? Quick 30m session to cover playbook and Slack shortcuts.

marta: Yes. I'll set the meeting. Owners: Docs (ashley) Wed EOD, Canary job (indra) Thu AM scheduled, Oncall overlap confirmed (vik + SRE) Thu-Fri, Pricing note (kevin) Wed EOD.

indra: Canary scheduled. I'll add grafana panels and a dashboard link to this thread once ready.

release-bot: Release ticket created: https://internal/release/2250 Stages: canary -> regional -> roll. Abort on p99 > 2x baseline or failure budget > 60% burn.

marta: Thanks all. If any owner slips on ETA, call it out here. Otherwise this is the checklist we'll present to the gatekeepers. :rocket:
